## Formal {.unnumbered}

## Examples {.unnumbered}








::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mat1 <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 3)
mat2 <- matrix(7:2, nrow = 3)

mat1 + 1
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     [,1] [,2]
[1,]    2    5
[2,]    3    6
[3,]    4    7
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mat1 / 2
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     [,1] [,2]
[1,]  0.5  2.0
[2,]  1.0  2.5
[3,]  1.5  3.0
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mat1 - mat2
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     [,1] [,2]
[1,]   -6    0
[2,]   -4    2
[3,]   -2    4
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mat1 * mat2
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     [,1] [,2]
[1,]    7   16
[2,]   12   15
[3,]   15   12
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
## Example of setting row and column names
mdat <- matrix(c(1,2,3, 11,12,13), nrow = 2, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE,
               dimnames = list(c("row1", "row2"),
                               c("C.1", "C.2", "C.3")))
mdat
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     C.1 C.2 C.3
row1   1   2   3
row2  11  12  13
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mat1 %*% 1:2
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     [,1]
[1,]    9
[2,]   12
[3,]   15
```


:::
:::
